foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat registration fee of $250.00 for the Foreign Registration Statement of a foreign limited liability company; the docketing statement (DSCB:15-134A) accompanies the filing.
foreignQualification.filedWith: Pennsylvania Department of State, Bureau of Corporations and Charitable Organizations
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File an Annual Report (DSCB:15-146) beginning in 2025, and maintain a Pennsylvania address (a post office box alone is not acceptable).

evidence.quote: Foreign Limited Liability Partnership/Limited Liability Company Fee Registration $250

Foreign filing associations and foreign limited liability partnerships desiring to do business in this Commonwealth must register with the Bureau of Corporations and Charitable Organizations by filing a Foreign Registration Statement [DSCB:15-412] accompanied by a docketing statement [DSCB:15-134A].
Beginning in 2025, most domestic and foreign filing associations are required to file an Annual Report [DSCB:15-146].
All entities filed with the bureau with the exception of fictitious names and trademarks, require a Pennsylvania address. A Post Office Box alone is not acceptable.
No advertising is required for other types of foreign filing associations or for foreign limited liability partnerships.

notes: The Department's fee schedule lists Registration at $250 for Foreign Limited Liability Partnership/Limited Liability Company; the same table lists Amendment of Foreign Registration at $250. The publication requirement on the foreign-associations page applies to foreign corporations, not to foreign limited liability companies.
